scope: Read-only local review of bounded existing-cycle continuation around the already authorized native HISTOR deployment
authorization: User explicitly requested rebuild/deployment; existing-cycle continuation preserves the work already running rather than requesting an additional fresh daily cycle.

candidateAcceptance.signedExactImageMomusAcceptance: Verified by parent and independent acceptance agent; archived under ../native/final-build/

resumeChangesReviewed: Operator-only idle assertion replaced by safe pre-deploy active-run snapshot
Snapshot uses existing Store reads with PostgreSQL default_transaction_read_only; no Services.build, schema, plan or run writes
Only run IDs, timestamps, aggregate counters and plan hashes are retained; no plan body, endpoints, settings or secrets are printed
Allow normal scheduler continuation for a bounded 25-second polling window plus existing per-call timeouts
One narrowly eligible existing admin/crawl API fallback after interruption and no active continuation; token remains inside current container
Normal independent-remote setting determines include_remote; HTTP409 is treated as an already-running result
Natural successful completion of either original or resumed run is recognized instead of forcing a fresh cycle or falsely rolling back
Active continuation requires an unfinished run and running flag
Same cycle, resumed-from ancestry, nondecreasing committed attempts, unchanged configured budgets, saved-plan hash and checkpoint-based classified consumption are checked
Rollback follows the same cycle ancestry, including an intermediate continuation run if one started on the new image
Original signed BuildOrder, candidate quality, actual MOMUS FixVerdict, signed DeployOrder, image/source/journal/health checks and signed rollback remain unchanged
limitations: Statistics checkpoints are30seconds; the proof does not promise recovery of uncommitted in-flight results or zero repeated provider requests.
If no package plan had been saved while planning, free registry planning may repeat; the helper records this explicitly.
requiredRepairBeforeApproval: Completed-run ancestry is explicitly queried using current.id, while prospective restart eligibility uses current.id+1 only after a finished row. Postconditions use ancestry, avoiding successful-completion None proofs and finished-error double counting.

revisionHistory.requiredRepairBeforeApproval: Successful completion of a newly resumed run is now recognized; its prior-chain proof excludes that successful run to avoid a false None proof and unnecessary rollback.

completionProofReviewed.reviewerNote: Reviewed actual helper branches plus the fixture script and recorded result; parent and operator confirmed the offline and real read-only snapshot checks. No redundant tests or remote actions were run by this reviewer.
